title.narrative: Gender Responsive Climate Instruments

description.narrative: The project will provide technical advisory services to selected GGGI Members on the integration of gender into climate instruments such as NDCs, NAPs, LTLEDS and other climate relevant plans and policies.Of particular relevance is the 2025 NDCenhancement process. The aim to to contribute to the enabling environment for gender specific outcomes in climate actions.
